_readme: Hand-maintained source for scripts/build-world-map.mjs. Facts rule (CLAUDE.md): a pin renders as verified only when verified=true. Set verified=true only after reading the venue on the event's own race site (public/data/past_races.json URLs; the race-site repos under _harvest/repos; the old f1tenth.org site repo) or the conference site; the 'source' field says where. Unverified pins render as hollow rings with a mono 'tbc' tag; never silently drop them. lat/lng 0,0 is a sentinel the chapter skips. Events are listed in CHRONOLOGICAL order and the chapter animates them in array order (upcoming last). number = the official 'Nth ... Grand Prix / Autonomous Racing Competition' from the race site title where it exists (ICRA 2026 = 27th, IV 2026 = 28th, IFAC 2026 = 29th, VTC 2026 = 30th, IROS 2026 = 31st). kind: race | madgames | workshop | course. status: held | upcoming | virtual (virtual = the competition ran online, the pin sits on the nominal host city and renders hollow). labelDx/labelDy: optional map-label nudge in viewBox units from the pin (labelDx < 0 anchors the text end on the left, labelDx 0 centers it); without them the chapter places labels greedily and drops the ones that would overlap. countries: partner / team countries for phase 1 (why = the page the affiliation was read from). Verified 2026-08-21 (builder C). Re-verified 2026-08-22 against the race sites (docs/EVENTS_VERIFICATION.md): the github.com/f1tenth/<conf><year>_race repos are private, so the GitHub Pages sites they publish and the old f1tenth.org site at f1tenth.github.io were read instead; iros2021 status changed virtual -> held on the strength of its in-person results page.
